s.n: Lewis's peanut butter and jelly bites
s.note: Lewis's peanut butter and jelly machine that explodes
s.how: Spread white bread with butter, peanut butter and strawberry jam. Cut off the crusts and slice each sandwich into four small triangles. Stack them high on a plate. Simple, but an inventor needs fuel.

s.note: Uncle Art, the intergalactic pizza delivery man
s.how: Roll pizza dough thin and cut into small rounds. Top each with pizza sauce, grated mozzarella, a slice of pepperoni and a pinch of oregano. Bake at 220C for 10 minutes until crisp and bubbling. Delivered from outer space.

m.note: Uncle Gaston firing meatballs across the dinner table
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with parmesan and an egg, roll into balls and brown. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and torn basil and simmer 40 minutes. Pile over 500g spaghetti for the whole wild family.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Pipe bright buttercream on top and add a little icing arrow pointing forward on each.

d.note: the villain who never thought it through
d.how: Freeze 500g red grapes overnight. Blend with 1 banana, 250ml grape juice and 200g vanilla yoghurt until smooth and thick. Pour into 4 glasses and serve straight away with straws.
